chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUbayd Allāh al-Arrajjānī, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the Zuhr prayer on Friday: how should we perform it while traveling? He said: You perform it while traveling as two rakʿahs, and the recitation in it is aloud.

key_terms.صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ: the Zuhr prayer, the noon salat (prayer)
key_terms.فِي السَّفَرِ: while traveling, in the state of سفر

ai.seo_question: How is the Friday Zuhr prayer performed during travel according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the Zuhr prayer on Friday during travel. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that it is performed as two rakʿahs in travel and that the recitation in it is to be done aloud.
